headline.text: Iran says it hit a US radar, US denies it
headline.context: Tensions rise again around the Strait of Hormuz.
headline.vo: Tensions are rising again around the Strait of Hormuz. Iran and the United States are trading claims over new attacks in the Gulf.

beats.text: Iran says it struck a US radar in *Bahrain*.
beats.vo: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Friday they destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. They said it was a response to a strike on a telecom tower in Sirik, in southern Iran. The claim could not be independently verified.

beats.quote: The IRGC launched two one-way attack drones toward Bahrain and both were shot down by U.S. forces.
beats.vo: The US military denied it. Central Command said two Iranian drones were shot down, with no injuries or damage.

text: Iran says a gas tanker hit a *mine*.
Trump says he would use *force* again.
beats.vo: Iran also said a tanker carrying liquefied gas hit a mine in the strait, without naming the ship. President Trump said the US totally controls the strait. He said he would have no hesitation in using force again.

title: Iran says it struck a US radar in Bahrain, the US military denies it
caption: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain after a strike on southern Iran; US Central Command says two Iranian drones were shot down, with no injuries or damage. Iran also says an LNG tanker hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump says the US controls the strait and would not hesitate to use force again.
